gaps.desktop: Someday icon colour: the loser draws the ~20px Someday archive box in a desaturated sage green (~#C1CA9D) with a flat lid, sitting between the teal Anytime stack and the green Logbook book, so three of the six smart-list icons read as one green family and Someday loses its identity at a glance; the winner uses a warm tan/khaki box (~#D5C898) with a distinct lid band and handle slot, giving every smart list its own hue.
gaps.phone: No create affordance: the loser's lists home has nothing in the bottom-right, so there is no + or New List control anywhere in the viewport and no way to add a list or to-do from the home screen. The winner floats a ~52px blue (#5796FF) circular + button with a soft drop shadow ~17px in from the right and bottom edges. The loser also parks a grey (#E1E5E8) 345x46px selection slab on Today, which reads as a stuck tap on an iOS list screen.

why: Desktop is near-identical, and the winner's distinct tan Someday icon keeps the smart-list hues separate. On phone the winner has a native floating + for creating items, while the loser has no add control and a stuck-looking Today highlight.
